main_text.head: De præterito plusquamperfecto.
main_text.p: Sic plusquamperfectum ἑτετύμμεθον Plusquāp. ἑτέτυφο ἑτέτυπτο.
main_text.head: Tertia persona pluralis.
main_text.p: Item tertia persona pluralis à tertia Notio. singulari fit, ponendo v ante ται, ut ᾠκ- ποίηται factus est, πεποίληται facti sunt, λέλυται λέλυνται. Si uero cōsonans prius ται antecesserit, nequit formari tertia pluralis, ut in τέτυπται λέλεκται πέπλησαγ ἑψαλται, non licet interponere ν,

page.notes: Greek text is partly uncertain at the line ends and in the marginal notes; the printed Greek accents and breathings may be imperfectly rendered. The bottom ornament is a small circle. Right-margin notes are Greek abbreviations of verb forms.
